python3 - <<'EOF'
p='specs/002-us-tags-backend/spec.md'
s=open(p).read()
rep={
'- Adding a tag the task already has (in any letter case): see FR-003 [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: Is adding a tag the task already has (e.g. "Work" when it has "work") a silent no-op that returns the task unchanged, or is it rejected with a validation message?]':
'- Adding a tag the task already has (in any letter case): a silent no-op; the request succeeds, the task is unchanged, and the tag counts once toward the 10 (FR-003; answered at the phase-00 review, 2026-09-26).',
'- Removing a tag the task doesn\'t have: see FR-005 [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: Is removing a tag the task doesn\'t have a silent no-op (success, task unchanged) or a "not found" error?]':
'- Removing a tag the task doesn\'t have: a silent no-op; the request succeeds and the task is unchanged. An unknown task id is still "not found" (FR-005; answered at the phase-00 review, 2026-09-26).',
'- A tag is looked up and stored in one letter case form: see FR-002 [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: Which spelling does the user see for a tag: always lower case ("Work" is stored and shown as "work"), or the spelling first used on that task?]':
'- A tag is looked up and stored in one letter case form: always lower case; "Work" is stored, matched, filtered and shown as "work" (FR-002; answered at the phase-00 review, 2026-09-26).',
'The spelling shown is open (see Edge Cases, tag spelling).':'Tags are shown in lower case (see Edge Cases, tag spelling).',
'adding a tag the task already has never creates a second one (BR-T2, AC-US1-5).':'adding a tag the task already has never creates a second one: it is a silent no-op (BR-T2, AC-US1-5).',
'afterwards the task no longer shows it and the tag filter no longer lists it (AC-US1-3).':'afterwards the task no longer shows it and the tag filter no longer lists it; removing a tag the task doesn\'t have is a silent no-op (AC-US1-3).',
}
for a,b in rep.items():
    assert s.count(a)==1,a; s=s.replace(a,b)
open(p,'w').write(s)

import json
p='loops/backend-dev/state/002-us-tags/requirements.json'
s=open(p).read()
rep={
' Spelling shown: open question.':' Tags are stored, matched, filtered and shown in lower case.',
' Whether that addition is a no-op or rejected: open question.':' Adding a tag the task already has is a silent no-op (success, task unchanged, counts once toward the 10).',
' Removing a tag the task doesn\'t have: open question.':' Removing a tag the task doesn\'t have is a silent no-op (success, task unchanged); an unknown task id is still not found.',
}
for a,b in rep.items():
    assert s.count(a)==1,a; s=s.replace(a,b)
json.loads(s); open(p,'w').write(s)

p='specs/002-us-tags-backend/checklists/requirements.md'
s=open(p).read()
rep={'- [ ] No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remain':'- [x] No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remain',
'''- 3 [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remain (tag spelling shown, adding a tag already on the task,
  removing a tag not on the task). They go to the phase-00 review as open questions; the loop does
  not ask them interactively.
- "Requirements are testable and unambiguous" is checked for everything outside those 3 markers.''':
'''- The 3 [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers (tag spelling shown, adding a tag already on the task,
  removing a tag not on the task) were answered at the phase-00 review (2026-09-26) and written
  into spec.md: lower case, silent no-op, silent no-op.'''}
for a,b in rep.items():
    assert s.count(a)==1,a; s=s.replace(a,b)
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='specs/002-us-tags-backend/plan.md'
s=open(p).read()
a='3 open questions left in spec.md as `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` (tag spelling, adding an existing tag, removing an absent tag); plan choices that aren\'t in the spec are listed as assumptions (research.md) for approval. | PASS (pending answers) |'
b='3 open questions (tag spelling, adding an existing tag, removing an absent tag) answered at the phase-00 review and written into spec.md; plan choices that aren\'t in the spec are listed as assumptions (research.md) for approval. | PASS |'
assert s.count(a)==1; open(p,'w').write(s.replace(a,b))

p='loops/backend-dev/outputs/002-us-tags/phase-00-review.md'
s=open(p).read()
assert s.count('## Open questions\n')==1
open(p,'w').write(s.replace('## Open questions\n','## Answered questions\n'))
EOF
sed -i 's/(recommended answer to Q\([123]\))/(answer to Q\1, confirmed at the phase-00 review)/' specs/002-us-tags-backend/research.md
grep -rn "NEEDS CLARIFICATION" specs/002-us-tags-backend/spec.md; grep -n "answer to Q" specs/002-us-tags-backend/research.md
